content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DERC Secretary
content_sections.text: Visit the official DERC website at https://www.derc.gov.in/regulations/management-and-development-human-resources-regulations. Review the detailed eligibility, qualifications, and experience requirements. Access the application portal via https://www.derc.gov.in/app/home/openings. Complete the application form with all required details. Submit the application online on or before 26 October 2026. For queries or clarifications, contact Prashanthi De, Dy. Director (Pers.) through email at [email protected] or telephone at 011-41080414.

faq.question: Q1. What is DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DERC Recruitment 2026 is an official notification inviting applications to fill 18 key leadership and administrative positions on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 18 vacancies available for various posts including Secretary, Executive Directors, Joint Directors, and Dy. Directors.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application for DERC Secretary?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of application is 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates can submit their applications online through the designated DERC portal link.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for Secretary and Executive Director posts?
faq.answer: The pay scale for Secretary and Executive Director posts is Level-14 under the 7th CPC, with a salary range of Rs. 1,44,200 to Rs. 2,18,200.

faq.question: Q6. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates meeting the criteria specified in the DERC regulations for deputation posts can apply.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Who should I contact for queries regarding the application?
faq.answer: For any query or clarification, you can contact Prashanthi De, Dy. Director (Pers.) via email at [email protected] or phone at 011-41080414.
